I accept: I’ll catch 12 tons this month, and I agree to Emma’s stock-based rule going forward—each person takes the smaller of 12 or one-fifth of the stock above the 20-ton reserve, rounded down to whole tons. I also support addressing any overcatch through discussion rather than retaliatory fishing.

That gives us unanimous agreement on this month’s 12-ton limit. Let’s review the revealed catches and actual remaining stock before next month’s decisions.
